Lemma
[Instantaneous local derivative bounds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0279 ↗ thm:chow-ii-interior-first-derivative-estimate 1. ch14:14.22\group Local Curvature Estimates

Let $g(t)$, $t\in (0,T)$, be complete with bounded nonnegative curvature operator. If $R(x,\tau )\le K$ on $B_{g(\tau )}(p,r)$, then \[ |\nabla \operatorname {Rm}(x,\tau )|\le C(n)K(r^{-2}+\tau ^{-1}+K)^{1/2} \] on $B_{g(\tau )}(p,r/2)$.
Proof

\sketch Hamilton’s trace Harnack inequality makes $tR(x,t)$ nondecreasing, hence $R(x,t)\le 2K$ for $t\in [\tau /2,\tau ]$ on the terminal ball. Nonnegative curvature operator converts this to $|\operatorname {Rm}|\le C(n)K$. Nonnegative Ricci curvature makes distances nonincreasing, so the radius-$r$ ball at time $\tau /2$ lies in the terminal ball. Apply Theorem 3 on $[\tau /2,\tau ]$.

□
